text: No. Pausing Smart money does not pause your Albert subscription payments, so you'll still be charged. To stop the charges, you'd need to deactivate or close your account. In the app, go to Profile (👤), tap the menu icon (☰), tap "Payments," then "Help center," and choose "Deactivate or close my accounts." Your Savings, Investing, and Cash balances must be $0, and any Instant or loan balances repaid, before you can close it.
